verdict.rationale: Superhuman Mail is an email client, so importing mail history and contacts is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence only shows that it connects to existing Gmail and Outlook accounts, which relies on the host provider rather than offering its own import. No documented capability exists for importing mail history or contacts from another provider or client.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can import my complete mail history and contacts from my old provider or client
